claim_boundary: Frozen observational resid_post carrier-distance geometry for four dense, instruction-tuned Transformers/CUDA model cells selected from complete local furnace artifacts after T5 was known. Each model receives the same fixed panel, carriers, distances, depths, endpoint, and multiplicity rule, but the study is not an independent confirmation of T5 and does not isolate model scale, family, tokenizer, instruction tuning, backend, node, or precision. No intervention, generation, behavior, semantic, mechanistic, causal, tokenizer-equivalence, backend-parity, direct cross-model magnitude, monotonic-decay, disappearance, duration, persistence, confirmatory, or Phase I paper-gate claim is authorized.
